newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Vincent plans HK$50.4 mln rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Vincent plans HK$50.4 mln rights issue.

text.p: Vincent Intertrans (Holdings) Ltd said it proposed to raise HK$50.4 million before expenses through a rights issue of about 219.14 million shares in the proportion of one rights share for every existing share held.

The freight forwarding company said the rights shares would be issued at HK$0.23 each, representing a 13.2 percent discount to the adjusted unaudited consolidated net tangible asset per share. Its shares were at HK$0.34 in late Wednesday morning.
Net proceeds of about HK$48 million after expenses will be used for redemption of a convertible note, it said.
